title: Khumi language
description: Kuki-Chin language spoken in Bangladesh and Burma
extract: Khumi, or Khumi Chin, is a Kuki-Chin language of Myanmar, with some speakers across the border in Bangladesh. Khumi shares 75%–87% lexical similarity with Eastern Khumi, and 78-81% similarity with Mro-Khimi. A written script for Khumi was created between 1930–1949 by E.W. Francis.
